targets.query:
from(bucket: "temi")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "robot_events" and r.event_type == "wave" and r._field == "count")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: sum, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(value: 0)
  |> yield(name: "waves")

from(bucket: "temi")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "robot_events" and r._field == "count")
  |> group(columns: ["event_type"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: sum, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(value: 0)
  |> yield(name: "events")

from(bucket: "temi")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "conversations" and r._field == "duration_s")
  |> group()
  |> mean()
  |> yield(name: "avg_duration")

from(bucket: "temi")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "conversations" and r._field == "duration_s")
  |> group()
  |> count()
  |> yield(name: "conversations")

from(bucket: "temi")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "conversations" and r._field == "duration_s")
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: count, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(value: 0)
  |> yield(name: "conversations_per_day")
